At the orchard's northern altar, Overseer Talathor is preparing a ritual for the cult. New recruits are directed there to learn more about their fellow members and the cult's plans, which promise power amid an apocalyptic future.
Overseer Sylandra is a humanoid overseer.
A visit credit for Stormwind's Valley of Heroes, one of three stops in the orchard's message-spreading task. The task directs its participant to wear the Doomsday Message while visiting the valley.
A visit credit for Westbrook Garrison, one of three stops in the orchard's message-spreading task. The task directs its participant to wear the Doomsday Message while visiting the garrison.
A visit credit for Goldshire, one of three stops in the orchard's message-spreading task. The task directs its participant to wear the Doomsday Message while visiting the town square.
A wind elemental held within a device and released when the device is opened. These elementals threaten Stormwind; their devices must be destroyed before they reach full strength.

Halion, the Twilight Destroyer, is a powerful hostile figure who calls himself the herald of Deathwing and claims mastery of light and darkness. His battle speech warns of shadow and describes pressure across the physical and twilight realms, while he reacts to changes between them.
Halion, the Twilight Destroyer, is a powerful hostile figure associated with Deathwing.

The Attuned Frog is a Sen'jin frog used as a tiny spy: “Da Perfect Spies” has players attune frogs at a sentry totem to gather information for Vol'jin.
Jun'do the Traitor is a humanoid.

Vanira is a humanoid.

A troll who answers Vol’jin’s call to recruit for the Darkspear cause. On being recruited, this volunteer voices eagerness to sign up, explicitly pledges support to Vol’jin, or offers help; the lines show willingness, not later training or service.
A Darkspear tiki warrior, presented as a formidable combatant.

Spirit of the Tiger is a tiger spirit creature.
The Tiger Matriarch is a named creature.

Zen'tabra is a Darkspear druid who has remained hidden while waiting to see whether Vol'jin would return. As the Darkspear return to the isles, she is ready to help Vol'jin in the coming battle. Her words show familiarity with a shaman's sharp eyes and frogs.
Zen'tabra Travel Form is a creature form associated with Zen'tabra.
The Troll Dance Leader is presented as a humanoid who leads a troll dance.
Dance Participant is a humanoid used in a dance scene.
Zalazane's Remains is identified as Zalazane's remains.
The Ritual Drummer is a creature assigned a ritual role. Out of combat, it casts Bang Ritual Gong.
Voice of the Spirits is a creature identified by a spirit-related title.
A Darkspear ancestor appears as a summoned spiritual figure associated with the Darkspear.
Tyrantus is identified as Kieupid's pet, a named beast.
Alenjon Sunblade is a Horde battlemaster whose dialogue frames fighting in a battleground as service to the Horde.
Bones of Bwonsamdi is an elite named figure whose name invokes Bwonsamdi.
A bat identified by its association with a scout.
A Charscale invoker, identified by a role centered on invocation.
A Charscale assaulter, identified by a direct assault role.
An elite Charscale, marked as an elite member of its kind.
A Charscale commander, identified by a command role among the Charscale.
A troll identified with voodoo; it is humanoid.
An internal quest-credit target listed among the required targets for Zalazane's Fall; its name ties it to the Echo Isles battle.
A Headless Ghost bearing the Dungeonmaster title.
An Earthen Ring Pathfinder and dungeon guide who warns that Ahune is being summoned by Twilight's Hammer cultists. The guide says that, if Ahune fully enters the world, an eternal winter will follow.

A battered brewer who blames Corin Direbrew and his Dark Iron associates for roughing up the brewer's employees and taking the brew after Corin was excluded from Brewfest competition. The brewer calls for someone to stop them.
A Steamwheedle Shyster who suspects the Crown Chemical Company is plotting another plague and wants its apothecaries served with court papers. He also proposes seizing the company's assets.
An Earthen Ring Scout and dungeon guide who warns that Ahune is being summoned by Twilight's Hammer cultists. The scout says that, if Ahune fully enters the world, an eternal winter will follow.

Elgin Clickspring is the High Tinker's assistant and helps keep the assault running on schedule. He expects Mekkatorque to return for more troops and urges people to speak with him soon, saying his boss hates delays. His remarks show concern for coordinating the assault and keeping it timely.
A troll celebrant.
Zild'jian is identified as Vol'jin's Wardrummer.
Zalazane is a humanoid.
A Frosty Flying Carpet beast.
Knight-Lieutenant T'Maire Sydes is identified as the Northrend Armor Quartermaster.
A Celestial Dragon non-combat pet.
The Celestial Steed is a beast.

Living Inferno is an elite creature that begins passive, then turns aggressive and joins combat across the zone.
Living Ember is an elemental combatant that casts Berserk.

Lil' XT is a mechanical companion with an eager, playful streak: it announces that it is ready to play, then admits when it is tired and needs a short rest. Its joke about something not bending the right way gives its voice a lightly comic edge.
Murkimus the Gladiator is a non-combat pet.
Ruby Drakes are dragonkin.
Mini Thor, titled “The Destroyer,” is a noncombat pet.
